articles.summary: Recovering an editable design file from a raster image is a common and costly bottleneck in modern design workflows, yet remains challenging since editability depends on recovering multi-modal attributes, such as typography, vector geometry, colors, grouping, and layer ordering. articles.title: Sol-Attn: Accelerating Video Generation Inference via On-the-Fly Attention Sparsification
